ideas.pitch: A rapid machine learning web dashboard that predicts polymer tensile strength and thermal stability based on molecular monomer composition.
ideas.title: PolyPredict AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core materials science theme of IIT Madras Amalgam by providing a tangible tool for discovering advanced polymers without tedious wet-lab experiments.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered lifecycle assessment calculator that evaluates biodegradable polymer alternatives for industrial packaging and sustainable manufacturing.
ideas.title: GreenPolymer LCA
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with industrial sustainability trends and provides clear, quantified environmental metrics which materials science judges value.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning digital twin predicting glass transition temperatures and viscosity curves for polymer melts in electronics and healthcare manufacturing.
ideas.title: PolymerGlass Viscosity Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages digital twin modeling techniques which have proven successful in engineering hackathons for predictive property monitoring.

ideas.pitch: A predictive modeling platform for evaluating polymer electrolyte membrane performance in hydrogen fuel cells and energy storage devices.
ideas.title: EnergyMembrane ML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-impact applications in energy storage and clean tech, capturing the attention of industry experts from IISc and IITs.

ideas.pitch: An automated computer vision and property estimation tool for detecting structural defects in polymer composites used in aerospace and transportation.
ideas.title: SmartPolymer QC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines predictive machine learning with a live, demonstrable image processing interface that works reliably during final judging.
